issues_found.title: Backup size 169KB under warn-bytes 1MB threshold
issues_found.details: Today's backup is 169619 bytes (~170KB), triggering soft warn (warn-bytes=1MB default). This is expected on a dev/local DB with sparse data (126 audit_logs, 5 z_reports, 191 orders, 59 items). For a real Le Cayenne production DB after a few weeks of operation, the size will naturally cross 1MB and warn will silence. Already logged as backup.daily.size_low — observability lane working as designed.
issues_found.action_required: None for V1 dev. In production, monitor that warn ceases ~2-4 weeks post-go-live; if it persists, investigate (could indicate truncation or empty DB).
